description: Full detail for one anime or manga by AniList ID. Returns synopsis, format, episode/chapter count, status, season, studios, source material, genres and tags (spoiler-flagged), AniList and MAL scores side by side, streaming links, cover/banner, and direct relations. Use anime_search_media first to find the AniList ID.

full_text.description: Render complete domain JSON in text, including full synopsis and every tag/relation on this response. Default false uses bounded summaries.

id.description: AniList media ID. Obtain from anime_search_media results.

name: anime_get_media

cover_image_url.description: Cover image URL (extra large), or null.

data_sources.description: Provenance: which sources contributed data to this response.

anilist.description: True when AniList data was successfully retrieved.

kitsu.description: True when Kitsu streaming data was successfully retrieved.

mal.description: True when MAL/Jikan data was successfully retrieved.

description.description: Normalized full plot synopsis text, or null.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: AniList returns null for the given ID (invalid or nonexistent). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

format.description: Format: TV, MOVIE, OVA, ONA, MANGA, NOVEL, etc.

full_text.description: Whether text renders the complete domain result as JSON.

id_mal.description: MyAnimeList ID used to cross-reference MAL data, or null.

is_adult.description: Whether this entry is marked adult/NSFW.

airing_at_utc.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp of the next airing.

time_until_airing_seconds.description: Seconds until next airing from now.

next_airing.description: Next airing episode info for currently airing anime, or null.

relations.description: Direct relations. Use anime_get_relations for a depth-bounded relation graph with heuristic ordering.

id.description: AniList ID of the related entry.

relation_type.description: Relation type: SEQUEL, PREQUEL, SIDE_STORY, SPIN_OFF, ALTERNATIVE, SOURCE, ADAPTATION, etc.

title.description: Romanized title of the related entry.

type.description: Media type of the related entry.

scores.description: Community scores. AniList uses a 0–100 scale; MAL uses 0–10.0. Both are returned separately.

anilist_mean.description: AniList mean score 0–100, from AniList community votes.

anilist_popularity.description: Number of AniList users with this in their list.

mal_popularity.description: MAL popularity rank (by list count), or null.

mal_rank.description: MAL rank by score, or null.

mal_score.description: MAL score 0–10.0, from MyAnimeList community. Null when MAL data unavailable.

mal_scored_by.description: Number of MAL users who scored this entry.

season.description: Broadcast season label, e.g. "FALL 2023", or null.

streaming_links.description: Streaming platform links (anime only). Empty for manga or when no streaming data is available.

dubs.description: Dub languages available on this platform.

subs.description: Subtitle languages available on this platform.

is_animation_studio.description: True when this is an animation studio.

is_main.description: True when this is the primary production studio.

tags.description: Content tags. Spoiler-flagged tags include is_spoiler: true.

is_adult.description: True when this is an adult tag.

is_spoiler.description: True when AniList marks this tag as a general spoiler.

title: Anime Get Media
